versions.content: If a UDP socket connection is configured with a SoAdSocketUdpAliveSupervisionTimeout and the re mote address was overwritten, as described in [SWS_SoAd_00592] , the alive supervision timer for this socket connection shall be started with the value specified by the configuration parameter SoAdSocketUdpAliveSupervisionTimeout .
